hook: What if you could ask your own health history?
caption: What if you could ask your own health history? Ask when you uploaded your blood report, and HealthGraph takes you to the entry: the date, the context, the day it happened. Your records, queryable, with the source behind every answer. Wellness info only, not medical advice. Explore HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop. #healthgraph #askyourrecords #healthhistory #digitalhealth #healthdata #personalhealth #healthapp #selftracking #healthjournal #connectedhistory

lines.text: What if you could ask your own health history?
lines.beat: Dark title card, chat input field fades in

lines.text: When did I upload my blood report?
lines.beat: ai-chat screen: question typed into the 'Ask about your health' input

lines.text: It reads your own history to answer.
lines.beat: ai-chat screen: answer bubble appears, 'Wellness info only' note visible

lines.text: It gives the date, not a guess.
lines.beat: Answer highlights the date, push-in on it

lines.text: And it can take you there.
lines.beat: Chat screen collapses, transition into health-graph

lines.text: Watch it open the day in your timeline.
lines.beat: daily-report card '3 OCT Today' opens, tabs slide in

lines.text: The entry is right there, in context.
lines.beat: daily-report: entry highlighted, footer 'Log x6, tap to open'

lines.text: No more hunting through folders by hand.
lines.beat: Ghosted folder icons dissolve behind the open record

lines.text: The answer comes with the record behind it.
lines.beat: Split view: answer on left, record on right, linked by a line
End card with wordmark and CTA
